downloadIntro.zh: Windows 与 Mac 版均已更新至 v1.59.20。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows and Mac are now v1.59.20. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: MT4 模拟盘交易（测试）：和 MT5 一样，在「账户 → 实盘」打开 MT4 账户，就能在复盘图表上下单、平仓、改止损止盈。需要在 MT4 里装新版 EA，勾选「允许 DLL 导入」时连接更快。目前只能连接模拟账户。
highlights.en: MT4 demo trading (beta): as with MT5, open an MT4 account under Accounts → Live to place orders, close positions and move stops and targets on the replay chart. Install the new EA in MT4; ticking "Allow DLL imports" makes the connection faster. Only demo accounts can be connected for now.

highlights.zh: K 线编号工具（Alt+N）：点一根 K 线，之后的 K 线会按间隔编号。可以设置起始数字、间隔、位置、字号和颜色，也能单独补标某一根。
highlights.en: Bar count tool (Alt+N): click a bar and the bars after it are numbered at an interval. Set the start number, interval, placement, font size and colour, or mark a single bar on its own.

highlights.zh: 历史交易聚光：在「历史」列表或复盘地图里选中一笔交易，图表其余部分会变暗，从进场到出场逐根展开并画出连线，标出进出场价格和净盈亏。再点一次就取消。
highlights.en: Trade spotlight: select a trade in the History list or on the replay map and the rest of the chart dims while the trade unfolds bar by bar from entry to exit, with its connector, entry and exit prices and net P/L. Click it again to clear it.

highlights.zh: MT 实盘（需要更新 EA）：报价列表里所有品种都有实时报价和当日涨跌，重启软件后也保留。实盘图表上可以用价格提醒和 K 线倒计时，每个品种按券商的小数位显示，切换账户时不再带着上一个账户的报价和持仓。MT 数据分成「MT4/MT5」（自己下载的）和「自动缓存」两页，新建训练时可以直接选 MT 账户的数据。
highlights.en: MT live trading (update the EA): every symbol in the quote list has a live price and day change, kept across app restarts. Price alerts and the candle countdown work on the live chart, each symbol shows its broker's decimals, and switching accounts no longer carries over the previous account's quotes and positions. MT data is split into MT4/MT5 (your downloads) and Automatic cache, and New training can start from an MT account's data.

highlights.zh: 副图指标的数值标签按大小整齐排开，不再挤在一起。可以在「设置 → 图表」里关掉，只看图例里的数值。
highlights.en: Indicator subplot value labels line up in value order instead of piling on top of each other. Turn them off in Settings → Chart to read the values in the legend only.

highlights.zh: Windows 上的下拉菜单打开时不再闪白。
highlights.en: Dropdowns on Windows no longer flash white when they open.

highlights.zh: 盲测存档揭晓前，历史、统计、日志、归集、CSV 导出和 AI 教练里都不显示日期。
highlights.en: Until a blind session is revealed, its dates stay hidden in History, Statistics, the journal, aggregated trades, CSV exports and the AI coach.

highlights.zh: 其他：统计不到 30 笔交易时不下结论，没有亏损单时盈利因子显示 ∞；止损移过开仓价后，图上显示锁定的盈利，金额小于 100 时显示到分；下单面板拉窄时，按钮和金额会自动缩短；期货月合约按交割月排序。
highlights.en: Also: Statistics gives no verdict below 30 trades and shows ∞ for a profit factor without losing trades; a stop moved past the entry shows the gain it locks in, with cents below 100; buttons and amounts shorten in a narrow order panel; futures month contracts sort by delivery month.

highlights.zh: 多窗格时，十字光标同步、持仓线和挂单线会画到其他品种的窗格上（比如金价的线出现在比特币窗格里）。
highlights.en: With several panes open, crosshair sync and position and order lines no longer spill onto panes of other instruments (gold's lines on a bitcoin pane).

highlights.zh: 交易：最小手数不是步长的整数倍时，按比例平仓没反应；SPX500 等股指的挂单价被取整到整数点；高倍速回放时，止盈成交价偏离设定价；在持仓行里输入方向不对的止损止盈，会立刻平仓。
highlights.en: Trading: percentage closes did nothing when the minimum lot was not a whole number of steps; SPX500 and other indices rounded pending prices to whole points; take-profits filled away from their level at high replay speeds; a stop or target typed on the wrong side of the market in a position row closed the position at once.

highlights.zh: Windows：点过确认弹窗后，输入框打不进字；用 Win+Shift+S 截图后，趋势线一直被锁在 0/45/90 度。
highlights.en: Windows: fields could not take typing after a confirmation dialog closed; after a Win+Shift+S screenshot, trend lines stayed locked to 0/45/90 degrees.

highlights.zh: 网络不稳时偶尔被登出，导致外汇和加密货币数据下载失败；统计诊断报告的 AI 点评总是生成失败。
highlights.en: An unstable network could sign the app out and make FX and crypto downloads fail; the AI comments in the statistics diagnosis report always failed to generate.
